endpoint_diagnosis.limits: No independent source declaration proves byte-cursor parameters, a separately stored offset or mutable parameters. Swapping local declarations merely to force prologue scheduling would be unsupported. Keep this as an uncompiled subsequent context question, not an endpoint spelling grid.
endpoint_diagnosis.possible_reentry: Independent evidence of the helper declaration or a discriminating coherent byte-cursor source frame; do not introduce an arbitrary offset solely to consume the missing five bytes.
